title: Archival and palaeoenvironmental documentation of extreme climate events reveals generational amnesia in collective memory (SongshGeo/shifting_baseline)
description: Analysis pipeline and agent-based model accompanying the manuscript Archival and palaeoenvironmental documentation of extreme climate events reveals generational amnesia in collective memory (submitted to Nature Communications). The code compares historical Chinese climate archives (1470–1900 CE) with tree-ring hydroclimate reconstructions validated against instrumental data (1901–2000 CE), quantifies the mismatch and sliding-window re-standardisation patterns, and runs the heuristic agent-based model (built on ABSESpy) that tests generational amnesia against collective memory illusion.
